name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Freshdesk offers a RESTful API (v2) for CRUD operations on tickets, contacts, and more.
auth_notes: Uses HTTP Basic Auth with the API key as the username and any non-empty password.
access_notes: API access is available on Growth, Pro, Enterprise, and legacy plans; trial users have limited access.

gate.process: Log in to Freshdesk, click profile picture, select Profile Settings, click View API key

api_breadth.reason: support check says this snippet does not establish api_breadth = 'unknown'

extras.rate_limits: Per-minute limits: Free 0, Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700; trial 50. Sub‑endpoint caps apply.

evidence.snippet: Freshdesk v2 uses HTTP Basic Authentication, but with a twist that confuses newcomers: your API key goes in the username field, and the password can be any non-empty string — `X` is the conventional throwaway value.
You need Growth, Pro, or Enterprise — or one of the legacy Blossom/Garden/Estate/Forest plans — for the key to do anything at all.
Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.
Note: This documentation is for the v2.0 of the APIs. Documentation for the v1.0 APIs can be found here.
The Freshworks Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI tools like Cursor and Claude to securely connect and interact with Freshdesk.
